name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.
texts: The key must never be dropped while the door is still closed in the same episode where the door is opened; i.e., the events key_lost and door_open must never both occur.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&key_lost, u3) -> -10
(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
(u2, key_lost, u3) -> -10
